_comment: Read by the daily blog-post routine. Pick ONE unused item below per run, preferring case-study angles roughly 1-in-3 days and general tips otherwise (avoid two case-study-angle posts about the SAME project back-to-back). After writing the post, set that item's "used": true and "usedDate": "YYYY-MM-DD", "slug": "<slug-you-created>" in the same PR. Never mark something used without actually publishing the matching post file in that PR. If ALL items are used, add new general-tip topics (same rules as content-brief: generic, no fabricated case studies) rather than repeating a used one.
